challenge: Reversible material changes stopped at a cryptographic named-human promotion gate even after scenario tests and live evidence were complete, forcing an interruption that did not improve the immediate decision surface.
observedFailure: PRs #30 and #32 passed implementation gates but remained blocked because an agent proposal could not and must not self-promote. The existing gate exposed no proof-backed autonomous lane and no larger-goal before/after view.
resolution: Added a deferred-review receipt that keeps events agent-proposed while binding the exact commit range and material-file coverage to content-addressed before and after live I/O, an intended-goal journey card, UI media when applicable, exact rollback verification, risk exclusions, and visible deferred human review. Authority-policy changes require a bound operator directive, and high-risk path classes fail closed.
knownLimitations: The operator directive is content-addressed but is not a canonical-event signature.
Static path exclusions are a conservative pre-action guard, not a semantic proof that arbitrary source code has no external effects.
Deferred review does not promote canonical Evolution history.
